clarification: The phrase same frozen V2.1 execution authority and assets in the base preregistration means same frozen asset projection. V2.1A training must use a separately versioned no-clobber execution authority whose implementation fields bind the V2.1A trainer, objective adapter, loss, preregistration, and this addendum. The baseline V2.1 authority is an immutable SHA-bound parent asset authority and is not itself training authorization for V2.1A.
